answer: Because the age is read from the velvet checkpoint rather than self-declared, the forge audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm thus means funding each alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the karst ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
